items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: So Grade Three is what I mostly do for Alfred so far.

ctx.x: Sure. I mean you obviously have to know about ranges and what that age level —
Right. It’s very specific. You know, Grade Three the second trumpet player, besides the first trumpet player, the second trumpet player can’t go higher than this, and the © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

trombone can’t go, and they can’t do this, and this can’t do that. And so yeah, there’s a lot of rules, and mostly I wrote Grade Three. Grade Two of course there’s even more rules of what you can’t do. And Grade One the ranges get smaller and smaller. So Grade Three is what I mostly do for Alfred so far.
